legend: The Flatwoods Monster (Flatwoods, West Virginia, USA, 12 September 1952)
lines: Flatwoods, West Virginia. September twelfth, nineteen fifty-two.
Just after dark, a glowing light drops onto a hillside farm.
Two boys, a mother and a young guardsman climb up to look.
A strange mist stings their eyes.
Then their flashlight finds two glowing green eyes.
They say a tall figure floated there, with a red face in a spade-shaped hood.
It drifted toward them, hissing, and everyone ran.
Next morning, searchers found only skid marks in the grass.
Skeptics blame a meteor and an owl, but the witnesses never changed their story.
Would you have climbed that hill?
title: The Flatwoods Monster: What Climbed Out of the Dark in 1952? #shorts
description:
In 1952, a glowing light fell on a West Virginia hill, and a group of locals said they met a tall figure with glowing eyes. Legend says it floated toward them in the mist.
